steps.title: Prepare DNase stock solution
steps.instruction: Make a 4 mg/mL DNase solution in ddH₂O, aliquot 0.55 mL, store at –20 °C (avoid freeze‑thaw); thawed aliquots can be kept at 4 °C for up to one month.

steps.title: Prepare ovomuccoid mixture
steps.instruction: Combine DNase, BSA and trypsin inhibitor in DMEM to make ovomuccoid; keep at 4 °C for up to one month.

steps.title: Prepare 0.5 % BSA in PBS
steps.instruction: Dissolve BSA to 0.5 % (w/v) in PBS (~50 mL per brain), filter with a vacuum filter until bubbles disappear, store at 4 °C (solution remains stable for up to one month).

steps.title: Prepare L‑cysteine solution
steps.instruction: Make 30 mg/mL L‑cysteine in DMEM, keep at 4 °C; use 0.2 mL per brain and discard any remaining after use.

steps.title: Prepare papain dissociation medium
steps.instruction: On the experimental day, combine papain and DNase in DMEM (omit L‑cysteine for now) to obtain 1–2 mL per brain; keep at 4 °C until just before use and discard any leftover.

steps.title: Set up dissection tubes
steps.instruction: For each sample, place a 7 mL universal tube with 2 mL papain medium for adult brains or 1 mL for neonatal/embryonic brains; add L‑cysteine and incubate 10 min at 37 °C.

steps.title: Sacrifice and dissect brain
steps.instruction: Humanely sacrifice the mouse, dissect the brain (or region of interest) as described for acute slices, and place it in a large weighing boat.

steps.title: Mince tissue in papain
steps.instruction: Cut the brain into small pieces with a scalpel, add the pieces to the papain medium, pool 2–3 embryonic or neonatal brains in 1 mL papain or use 2 mL for each adult brain, then further mince with scissors.

steps.title: Enzymatic digestion
steps.instruction: Incubate the tissue suspension for 1 h at 37 °C.

steps.title: Prepare reagents for myelin removal
steps.instruction: While digestion proceeds, chill ovomuccoid, PBS and BSA on ice; set up 7 × 15 mL tubes (for 3 LS columns per sample) and one 50 mL tube per sample; ready LS MACS columns, MidiMACS separators and MACS multistand.

steps.title: Terminate digestion with ovomuccoid
steps.instruction: Add 1 mL ovomuccoid to the digestion mixture to inhibit papain activity.

steps.title: Wash and resuspend cells
steps.instruction: Resuspend the tissue, transfer to a 15 mL tube, bring the volume to 8 mL with ovomuccoid, centrifuge 10 min at 300 g, then wash in 7 mL ice‑cold PBS.

steps.title: Myelin removal (optional for young tissue)
steps.instruction: Perform myelin removal on ice in a biosafety cabinet using Miltenyi Myelin Removal Beads II according to the manufacturer’s magnetic labeling and depletion protocol with LS columns; filter through a 70 µm strainer before labeling; wait for columns to empty before washing; combine flow‑through from all columns. Omit this step for embryonic and neonatal samples if desired.

steps.title: OPC isolation with CD140 beads
steps.instruction: Isolate OPCs on ice in a biosafety cabinet using Miltenyi CD140 (PDGFRα) MicroBeads per the manufacturer’s instructions for magnetic labeling and separation with MS columns; prepare MS columns, MiniMACS separators, MACS MultiStand and two 15 mL tubes per sample; remove columns from the separator before collecting the eluate.

steps.title: Extract RNA with RNeasy Micro Kit
steps.instruction: Extract total RNA using Qiagen RNeasy Micro Kit, following the kit protocol and including the on‑column DNase step; add β‑mercaptoethanol to buffer RLT (handle with gloves in a fume hood); perform all steps on ice in a biosafety cabinet; store extracted RNA at –80 °C until all samples are processed.

steps.title: Assess RNA quality and quantity
steps.instruction: Quantify RNA with a Qubit fluorometer (expected 250 pg–10 ng per sample after MACS), then measure the RNA Integrity Number (RIN) on an Agilent Bioanalyzer; accept samples with RIN > 7.

steps.title: Prepare RNA‑seq library
steps.instruction: Construct libraries using Takara‑Clontech SMARTer Stranded Total RNA‑seq Kit v2 – Pico Input Mammalian according to the manufacturer’s protocol.

steps.title: Sequence libraries
steps.instruction: Sequence the libraries on an Illumina sequencer (or equivalent platform).

steps.title: Process sequencing data
steps.instruction: Trim reads for quality (e.g., Trim Galore!), align to the mouse genome (GRCm38/mm10) with Tophat 2.1.1, normalize and perform differential expression analysis (e.g., DESeq2), and optionally conduct GO term analysis with DAVID and REVIGO.
